build.note: timestamp-free artifact: rebuild reproduces identical bytes

fields_per_node.candidates: list of {token, prob}; prob = linear blend of the contributing measured bins' probabilities; sum(prob) <= 1 (only top-30 measured per bin; residual mass unmeasured, not fabricated)
fields_per_node.provenance: {source_bins: contributing measured bin indices, weights: blend weight per contributing bin, n: measured items behind the node}
fields_per_node.value: node coordinate on the [0,1] axis grid (float, 0.01 grid)

interpolation.candidate_source: union of the contributing measured bins' top-30 non-whitespace token lists
interpolation.mode: piecewise-linear blend of adjacent measured bins (RE-DERIVED from measured top-30 lists; no fresh sampling)
